decisions.reason: As a prominently launched track-system accessory close to the firm’s core lighting business, it is likely to stay unless clearly below aspirations, and its low resource burden gives management slack to keep it longer.

A standalone LED luminaire faces strong competition and short product cycles, so if its results were only average or below peer offerings, boundedly rational management would be fairly likely to redeploy resources.

The home automation server box is the most peripheral and technologically uncertain product, so a likely shortfall versus aspirations would trigger problemistic search and make withdrawal the more probable choice.

A luminaire family presented on its own page suggests a broader platform investment in the firm’s core market, which German manufacturing management would usually retain while performance remains uncertain but not clearly unsatisfactory.
